reviews.title: iDrive 8 System Crashes, Reboots & Screen Blank
reviews.howToFix: Install latest iDrive software via OTA update (Settings > Software Update). Version .63+ resolved many stability issues. reviews.title: Rear Brake Disc Corrosion and Caliper Seizure from Regen Under-Use
reviews.howToFix: Periodically perform deliberate hard stops (BMW recommends this) or select a lower/adaptive regen mode so the friction brakes engage and clean themselves; in salty/humid regions service the rear calipers (clean and re-lube slide pins, free the pistons) at least annually.
